items.t: 6-speed automatic harsh shifts, limp mode or failure
items.job: Replace 62TE transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Software updates or a solenoid kit cost much less; one owner paid about $2,900 for a solenoid repair at a dealer.

items.t: Diesel automated manual stuck in neutral or won't move
items.job: Repair or replace the automated manual's hydraulic unit
items.note: A hydraulic unit runs about $1,000 out the door. A complete new transmission from Mopar is about $9,200 installed.

items.t: Overheating and coolant leaks
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,500-$2,100 total for a radiator. Have a pressure test done first; a leaking hose costs much less.

items.t: Radiator fan circuit can overheat and cause a fire (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Engine cooling fan can seize and overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Power steering assist weakens or quits
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,155-$1,257 total for 2014-2021 vans.

items.t: Water in steering harness can cut power steering (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Stalling or sudden loss of power
items.job: Diagnose engine codes and check for recalls and updates
items.note: Diagnosis only; the repair depends on the cause, and recall fixes are free.

items.t: Parking brake won't hold or sticks on
items.job: Replace rear parking brake shoes and adjust cables
items.note: One owner paid about $1,400 at a dealer when more of the rear brakes were replaced.

items.t: Brakes squeal from new
items.note: Often free when the van is new; RepairPal lists about $420-$630 for a pad job on most years.
